description: Establish a green baseline and a zero-spend preflight gate. Today the repo has no build, no tests and no way to check whether an expensive launch is even viable before paying for it, which is how the prior run burned ~$353. This feature (a) validates the two existing scripts syntactically, (b) adds scripts/preflight.sh which answers every go/no-go question using only read-only AWS APIs, the HuggingFace API and run-instances --dry-run, and (c) provisions the free AWS prerequisites (S3 results bucket, IAM role + instance profile with SSM and scoped S3 write) and closes the two leftover security problems. No EC2 instance is launched and no compute is billed by this feature. Must be done first because FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 both depend on the bucket name, the instance profile name and the preflight helpers.
steps: Confirm the baseline: run `bash -n scripts/run-benchmark.sh scripts/compare-results.sh` and record the result. Try to obtain shellcheck via `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/mnt" koalaman/shellcheck:stable scripts/*.sh` (check `docker info` first) or by downloading the static binary from the shellcheck GitHub releases; if neither is possible, note that in findings and rely on `bash -n`. Do not fix pre-existing shellcheck noise in run-benchmark.sh in this feature beyond what FEAT-003 explicitly changes.
Add a .gitignore that ignores results/* except results/.gitkeep, plus /tmp-style scratch artifacts (rendered user-data, downloaded checkpoint manifests). results/.gitkeep must remain tracked.

Create scripts/preflight.sh following the house style of scripts/run-benchmark.sh exactly: `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, `set -euo pipefail`, banner comment, all-caps `VAR="${VAR:-default}"` config block, a `usage()` heredoc with Chinese help text, a `while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]` long-option parser, and the `log()` helper printing `[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*`. Options at minimum: --region (default us-east-2), --az (default us-east-2a), --instance-type (default p5en.48xlarge), --model (default deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash), --bucket, --help. Every aws call must pass --region explicitly because the sandbox exports AWS_REGION=us-east-1.
preflight.sh check 1 - identity and region: `aws sts get-caller-identity` and assert the account is 077090643075; print the resolved region and AZ.

preflight.sh check 2 - spot quota: `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-7212CCBC` ('All P Spot Instance Requests', 768 vCPUs in us-east-2) and compare against the vCPU count of the requested instance type read from `aws ec2 describe-instance-types`. Do NOT use L-3819A6DF, which is the G/VT quota. FAIL the check if required vCPUs exceed the quota.

preflight.sh check 3 - instance store: read `InstanceTypes[0].InstanceStorageInfo` via describe-instance-types and print disk count, per-disk size and total. For p5en.48xlarge this must report 8 x 3800 GB = 30400 GB. FAIL the check if InstanceStorageInfo is null, because the whole design depends on local NVMe.

preflight.sh check 4 - spot price: `aws ec2 describe-spot-price-history --instance-types <type> --product-descriptions Linux/UNIX --start-time now`, print price per AZ, and FAIL if the price for the target AZ exceeds a --max-price ceiling (default 35.00, matching what the prior launch used).

preflight.sh check 5 - AMI resolution: resolve the Deep Learning Base OSS Nvidia Driver GPU AMI for Ubuntu 22.04 dynamically rather than hardcoding ami-0b80a5f61a0bca5dd. Prefer the SSM public parameter path under /aws/service/deeplearning/ (enumerate with `aws ssm get-parameters-by-path --path /aws/service/deeplearning --recursive` to find the real name, since the exact path must be discovered not guessed); fall back to `aws ec2 describe-images --owners amazon --filters Name=name,Values='Deep Learning Base OSS Nvidia Driver GPU AMI (Ubuntu 22.04)*'` sorted by CreationDate descending. Print the resolved AMI id, name and creation date. Allow an --image-id override.

preflight.sh check 6 - checkpoint sizing: query the HuggingFace API for the requested model with `?blobs=true` and sum siblings[].size to get exact bytes; print total GB and GiB, the file count, config.json expert_dtype and quantization_config.quant_method, and whether gated is true. Compare the total against the usable space of the planned storage target and FAIL if it does not fit. Known good values to sanity-check against: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash = 73 files / 159.6 GB / 148.6 GiB / expert_dtype fp4; deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 = 74 files / 166.9 GB / expert_dtype fp4; sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 = 55 files / 294.1 GB / 273.9 GiB. Emit an explicit warning when expert_dtype is fp4 and the target GPU is Hopper (H200/H100, SM90), naming the two supported Hopper options from context.json upstream_findings.

preflight.sh check 7 - subnet and SG: verify subnet-09bfc4e5573173d64 exists and is in the requested AZ (allow a --subnet-id override), and report the ingress rules of the security group that will be used.

preflight.sh check 8 - dry-run launch: assemble the same run-instances argument list FEAT-002 will use and invoke it with --dry-run, treating the DryRunOperation error as PASS and any other error as FAIL with the message printed verbatim.
End preflight.sh with a PASS/FAIL summary table (one row per check) and exit non-zero if any check failed. Make the summary the last thing printed so it is readable in a log tail.

Provision the free AWS prerequisites in a separate script scripts/setup-infra.sh (idempotent, safe to re-run, --region default us-east-2): create S3 bucket tpot-bench-results-077090643075-us-east-2 with public access blocked, default SSE and versioning off; create IAM role tpot-bench-ec2-role with an ec2.amazonaws.com trust policy, attach the AWS managed policy AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore, and attach an inline policy granting s3:PutObject/s3:GetObject/s3:AbortMultipartUpload/s3:ListBucket scoped to that one bucket ARN plus cloudwatch:PutMetricData and ec2:TerminateInstances restricted by a condition on the aws:ResourceTag/Project=tpot-benchmark tag; create instance profile tpot-bench-ec2-profile and add the role to it. Print every ARN it creates or finds. IAM and S3 creation is free; the script must not create any EC2 resource.

In the same setup-infra.sh, add a --harden-existing flag that revokes the SSH 0.0.0.0/0 ingress rule on sg-0775ac013a1b6080d and deletes key pair tpot-bench-key (key-0934f6d789a375508), whose private key is lost and which the new SSM-based design does not need. Guard both with an existence check so re-runs are no-ops. Do not touch the two unrelated 250 GB st1 volumes in us-east-2b/2c.

Run setup-infra.sh with --harden-existing against the real account, then run preflight.sh end to end, and paste both summaries into the feature's findings field along with an explicit list of every AWS resource created, modified or deleted.
acceptance_criteria: `bash scripts/preflight.sh --region us-east-2 --az us-east-2a` runs to completion and prints a PASS/FAIL row for all 8 checks; the run costs nothing because it makes only describe-*/get-* calls plus run-instances --dry-run.
preflight.sh reports p5en.48xlarge instance storage as 8 disks x 3800 GB = 30400 GB, and reports the P spot quota from L-7212CCBC as 768 vCPUs against a 192 vCPU requirement.
preflight.sh reports deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash as 73 files totalling 159.6 GB with expert_dtype fp4, and prints the Hopper-no-native-FP4 warning naming both supported Hopper options.
preflight.sh resolves a Deep Learning Base OSS Nvidia Driver GPU AMI id dynamically and does not contain the literal string ami-0b80a5f61a0bca5dd except as a documented comment.
preflight.sh exits non-zero when a check fails; demonstrate this by running it once with --max-price 1.00 so the spot-price check fails, and confirm the exit status is non-zero.
`aws iam get-instance-profile --instance-profile-name tpot-bench-ec2-profile` succeeds and the attached role has AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore plus the scoped inline policy.
`aws s3api head-bucket --bucket tpot-bench-results-077090643075-us-east-2` succeeds and `aws s3api get-public-access-block` shows all four blocks true.

`aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0775ac013a1b6080d --region us-east-2` shows no ingress rule with CidrIp 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22, and `aws ec2 describe-key-pairs --region us-east-2` no longer lists tpot-bench-key.
Re-running setup-infra.sh --harden-existing a second time exits 0 and creates nothing new (idempotent).

No EC2 instance was launched and no spot request was created by this feature; confirm with `aws ec2 describe-instances --region us-east-2 --filters Name=instance-state-name,Values=pending,running` returning empty.
verification: bash scripts/preflight.sh --region us-east-2 --az us-east-2a  (expect exit 0 and 8 PASS rows)
bash scripts/preflight.sh --region us-east-2 --az us-east-2a --max-price 1.00  (expect non-zero exit, spot price check FAIL)
bash scripts/setup-infra.sh --region us-east-2 --harden-existing  (run twice, expect exit 0 both times)
aws ec2 describe-instances --region us-east-2 --filters Name=instance-state-name,Values=pending,running --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].InstanceId' --output text  (expect empty)
findings:
ALL 11 ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA MET. Zero compute spend: no EC2 instance launched, no spot request created, only describe-*/get-* calls plus run-instances --dry-run.

=== FILES ADDED ===
- scripts/preflight.sh (mode 100755, ~520 lines) - 8-check zero-spend go/no-go gate.
- scripts/setup-infra.sh (mode 100755, ~380 lines) - idempotent free-prerequisite provisioner with --harden-existing.
- .gitignore - ignores results/* except results/.gitkeep (verified still tracked), plus user-data*.sh / *.user-data / *.rendered / *-manifest.json / hf-*.json / checkpoint-*.json / .scratch/ / tmp/ / *.tmp / *.log / *.pem / *.key.

=== NAMES FEAT-002 AND FEAT-003 MUST CONSUME (exact) ===
- S3 bucket: tpot-bench-results-077090643075-us-east-2 (ARN arn:aws:s3:::tpot-bench-results-077090643075-us-east-2). Derived at runtime as tpot-bench-results-<account>-<region>, overridable with --bucket / $BUCKET in both scripts.
- IAM role: tpot-bench-ec2-role (arn:aws:iam::077090643075:role/tpot-bench-ec2-role)
- IAM instance profile: tpot-bench-ec2-profile (arn:aws:iam::077090643075:instance-profile/tpot-bench-ec2-profile)
- Inline policy on the role: tpot-bench-scoped-access
- Project tag used by the ec2:TerminateInstances IAM condition: Project=tpot-benchmark. FEAT-002's launcher MUST tag the instance Project=tpot-benchmark or the self-terminate watchdog will be denied.

=== RESOLVED AMI (do not hardcode) ===
- SSM public parameter path, discovered by enumerating /aws/service/deeplearning (not guessed): /aws/service/deeplearning/ami/x86_64/base-oss-nvidia-driver-gpu-ubuntu-22.04/latest/ami-id
- Resolves in us-east-2 to ami-0b80a5f61a0bca5dd = "Deep Learning Base OSS Nvidia Driver GPU AMI (Ubuntu 22.04) 20260804", created 2026-08-04T15:56:58.000Z, x86_64. This is the SAME AMI the failed run used, which confirms the AMI was never the problem - disk layout was.
- Fallback path implemented: describe-images --owners amazon --filters Name=name,Values='Deep Learning Base OSS Nvidia Driver GPU AMI (Ubuntu 22.04)*' with sort_by(...,&CreationDate)[-1].
- The literal ami-0b80a5f61a0bca5dd appears in preflight.sh exactly once, on comment line 40, and zero times in non-comment lines (verified by grep).

Warnings emitted (4): the fp4-on-Hopper block naming both cookbook options, i.e. (a) original FP4 checkpoint via W4A16 Marlin MoE kernels, TP-only, no DP-attention/DeepEP; (b) sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 (55 files / 294.1 GB / 273.9 GiB) which unlocks DP-attention + DeepEP; plus the note that DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base is FP8 but cookbook-forbidden for chat/tool calling.

FAIL-path demo: `bash scripts/preflight.sh --region us-east-2 --az us-east-2a --max-price 1.00` -> EXIT=1, row 4 = FAIL 'us-east-2a 现价 $26.661700/hr 超过上限 $1.00/hr', other 7 rows still PASS. Confirms non-zero exit on failure.

=== ENVIRONMENT / TOOLING NOTES FOR FEAT-002 AND FEAT-003 ===
- shellcheck IS obtainable: the docker daemon IS running in this sandbox (`docker info` exit 0) and `docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/mnt" -w /mnt koalaman/shellcheck:stable scripts/*.sh` works. Use it. preflight.sh and setup-infra.sh are shellcheck-clean (exit 0, zero findings) after three fixes: SC2329 disable comments on the trap-invoked cleanup(), SC2016 disable comment on the JMESPath containing backticks, and replacing `sed 's/^/    /'` with a read loop (SC2001).
- Pre-existing shellcheck baseline, left untouched per the step instructions: scripts/run-benchmark.sh has exactly 1 finding, SC2329 info on cleanup() at line 104 (a false positive, it is invoked by `trap cleanup EXIT`). scripts/compare-results.sh has 0 findings.
- The environment exports AWS_REGION=us-east-1. Every aws call in both new scripts passes --region explicitly. Do the same in FEAT-002/FEAT-003.
- printf '%-Ns' misaligns CJK column headers because it counts characters, not display columns. preflight.sh solves this with a render_table() helper that pads using unicodedata.east_asian_width. Reuse that approach for any new summary table.
- JMESPath gotcha: `IpPermissions[?FromPort==\`22\`].IpRanges[?CidrIp=='0.0.0.0/0'].CidrIp` silently returns empty because of nested filter projections. The working form is `IpPermissions[?FromPort==\`22\` && ToPort==\`22\` && IpProtocol=='tcp'] | [].IpRanges[] | [?CidrIp=='0.0.0.0/0'].CidrIp`.
- New S3 buckets in this account already come with public access block and default SSE-S3 applied by AWS, so setup-infra.sh reported those two as already-present on the very first run. BucketKeyEnabled is therefore false rather than the true the script would have set; harmless, default SSE is active.
- describe-spot-price-history --start-time must be `now` as an ISO-8601 UTC stamp: `$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')`.
- Live HuggingFace numbers for deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash confirmed on this run: 73 files, 159630041626 bytes = 159.6 GB = 148.7 GiB (context.json says 148.6 GiB; 148.66 rounds to 148.7 at one decimal, so this is a rounding difference, not a drift). config.json: expert_dtype=fp4, quantization_config.quant_method=fp8, num_nextn_predict_layers=1, gated=false.
- preflight.sh plans the checkpoint target as the instance-store RAID0 total minus STORAGE_RESERVE_PCT (default 10%), i.e. 27360 GB usable of 30400 GB on p5en.48xlarge. FEAT-002's bootstrap must actually build that RAID0 and mount it; if it reserves a different fraction, pass --storage-reserve-pct / $STORAGE_RESERVE_PCT so the two agree.
- The exact run-instances argument list preflight.sh dry-runs (FEAT-002 should stay parameter-compatible): --image-id <resolved> --instance-type <type> --count 1 --subnet-id subnet-09bfc4e5573173d64 --security-group-ids sg-0775ac013a1b6080d --iam-instance-profile Name=tpot-bench-ec2-profile --instance-initiated-shutdown-behavior terminate --metadata-options HttpTokens=required,HttpEndpoint=enabled,HttpPutResponseHopLimit=2 --block-device-mappings [{"DeviceName":"/dev/sda1","Ebs":{"VolumeSize":200,"VolumeType":"gp3","DeleteOnTermination":true}}] --instance-market-options MarketType=spot,SpotOptions={MaxPrice=<max>,SpotInstanceType=one-time,InstanceInterruptionBehavior=terminate} --tag-specifications ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=Project,Value=tpot-benchmark},{Key=Name,Value=tpot-bench-<type-with-dashes>}]. HttpPutResponseHopLimit=2 is set so containers can still reach IMDSv2.
- preflight.sh only adds --iam-instance-profile to the dry-run when the profile already exists, so it degrades gracefully if run before setup-infra.sh. Run setup-infra.sh first.
- No deviations from the planned steps. Nothing was blocked.
